data.description:
## The defect (same class as c5b3-1b8a-08dd-40af)

Found by the ticket-c5b3 sibling sweep. `src/rebar/metrics/analyzers/lizard_complexity.py`
ends `analyze` with:

    files = _file_complexity(lizard.analyze([str(root)]), root)
    return AnalyzerResult(complexity={"files": files, "functions": ..., "total_ccn": ...,
                                      "max_ccn": max(..., default=0)})

There is no guard on `files` being empty. If `lizard.analyze` yields zero file records --
because the scan root holds no language lizard supports, because the root is empty, or because
a scan silently produced nothing -- the adapter returns
`AnalyzerResult(complexity={"files": {}, "functions": 0, "total_ccn": 0, "max_ccn": 0})`.

That is a CONFIDENT ZERO published with `confidence: high, source: structural`: a reader
concludes the repository has no complexity, when in fact nothing was measured. It is the
identical failure mode ticket c5b3 fixed in the scc adapter, in a different tool's adapter,
and the same one epic 839b-f6d2-7e1a-4051 was created to eliminate ("fabricated authoritative
zeros"). `rebar.metrics.registry.Unavailable` is the correct representation of
"measured nothing".

Not currently reproducing on this repository (lizard measures 1708 files here), which is why
it was found by sweep rather than by observation. It is latent, and it fires for exactly the
clients epic 839b's polyglot adoption was meant to serve -- a repository of a language lizard
does not support gets a confident zero rather than an honest Unavailable.

## Why it was not fixed inside c5b3

c5b3's acceptance criteria and the operator's ruling are scoped to the scc adapter and the
module-size metric. Fixing a second adapter there would have widened a bug fix past its
ticket and past its review. Filed instead, per the sibling-sweep disposition rule.

## Also worth checking in the same pass

`src/rebar/metrics/analyzers/jscpd_dup.py` returns whatever `run_jscpd` produces without
inspecting whether any file was scanned. A duplication percentage of 0 over zero scanned files
is the same fabricated zero; confirm whether `run_jscpd`'s payload distinguishes the two before
deciding whether it needs the same guard.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] An empty lizard file map is reported as `Unavailable`, never a zero-valued
      `AnalyzerResult` -- proven RED-first with a test that fails on the current return.
- [ ] The jscpd adapter is inspected for the same fabricated zero and either fixed under the
      same rule or explicitly ruled out with the reason recorded.
- [ ] A regression asserts a scan root that demonstrably contains analyzable files never
      yields a zero-valued complexity result.
data.title: lizard adapter reports a confident ZERO complexity when it measures no files
